title: Shepseskaf
summary: King listed in CFAH-7B Table 7 (Egypt Dynasties 3–4 (Memphis)).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasties 3–4 (Memphis). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-7B (Table 7, "Integrated Dates for Dynasties 3 & 4").

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (CFAH non-anchor dates). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: Start Co-Rex: ~1825; Death or Deposition: 1818. Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-11-13): was none.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7B: Kings of Dynasties 1-13," OSF preprint v1.3 (10 Feb 2026), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/TUWNC, file CFAH 7-B Kings of Dynasties 1-13_v_1.3.pdf, Table 7 "Integrated Dates for Dynasties 3 & 4", p. 94
